_: The cavalry (army.json units.horse): one Meshy model of the knight on his barded warhorse (docs/art/army/knight_mounted2_side.png, drawn over the CC0 horse rig's own side view), fitted to that rig by tools/beast_rig.py (fit y: one even scale from its length). Below the caparison's hem its legs are the rig's own horse legs with their own weights (tools/rig/mount_legs.py), so they bend at the true knee and hock in every gait; they wear the model's bay coat and hooves. Kept in ~/code/goc-kits/meshy/army/mounted2/rigged (mounted_legs.glb, albedo.png, mask.png). Baked: Blender -b --python realm/tools/vat_bake.py -- ~/code/goc-kits/meshy/army/mounted2/rigged/mounted_legs.glb realm/assets/armies/cavalry realm/tools/rig/cavalry.json, then albedo.png and mask.png copied beside it.
